prompt: I'm building a TV home screen with @lightningjs/core (Lightning v2). I have a `PosterRow` component that renders a horizontal row of movie poster tiles from an array of movie objects (title, image). Right now the remote control does nothing on this row — left/right don't move between posters and Enter doesn't do anything. Add focus handling so the user can navigate between posters with left/right and pressing Enter logs the selected movie's title to the console. Here's my component.
assertions: The component implements _getFocused() returning the currently focused poster child (Lightning's real focus delegation mechanism)
Left/right navigation is implemented via Lightning key-handler methods (e.g. _handleLeft/_handleRight) that update a tracked selected index, not via DOM event listeners
Pressing Enter logs the selected movie's title to the console (via _handleEnter on the row or its child, or an equivalent delegation)
No DOM/CSS/React syntax is introduced (no addEventListener, document, className, style={{}}, JSX)
The selected index is bounds-checked so navigating past the first/last poster doesn't throw or select an out-of-range item
